macros.name: gitArg
macros.doc: \gitArg{id}{prefix}{suffix} allocates an additional file, whose name will be composed of the optional prefix and suffix.

macros.name: gitLoad
macros.doc: This LaTeX package provides the command \gitLoad that can load a specific file from a specific git repository and, optionally, pipe the file contents through a program for post-processing.

macros.name: gitUrl
macros.doc: \gitUrl{id} returns the full URL to the file in the git repository online.
